subjects.name: Mark Aitken
subjects.profile: Mark Aitken — First Baseman, Oakland A's Legend — Player Rep, Community Liaison — Jack London

sources.name: Desmond Morton
sources.quote: You know, when the team's rolling like this, it's less about any one guy and more about how we all fit together. I've been around long enough to see how roles shift—some days you're the spark, some days you're just keeping the line moving. It's not always flashy, but it's how you sustain something. Feels like the whole city's leaning into that right now.

sources.name: Mark Aitken
sources.quote: When you're part of a team that's been around as long as the A's, you start to see how roles evolve—not just on the field, but in the community too. It's like a living structure, where each player's contribution shifts over time, but the core stays the same. It's about adapting while keeping the team's spirit intact.

sources.name: Marcus King
sources.quote: I don’t really follow sports much, but I’ve heard people talking about the A’s record lately. It seems like they’re doing alright this season.

sources.name: Jacob Perez
sources.quote: Honestly, I don't follow sports much, but I did hear some guys at the gas station talking about the A's record. Seems like they're doing okay this cycle, but I'm just focused on my deliveries.
